summary: Iteration 8 — verified two new report endpoints (/api/reports/staff, /api/reports/expenses) and their ReportsDialog tabs. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_reports_staff_expenses.py — empty-shape validation (no query + far-past date), populated flow (opened shift with staff A, recorded CASH IN 100 + UPI IN 200 against existing bank + CASH OUT 50), staff report row asserts (shifts_opened>=1, transaction_count>=2, totals.IN>=300, totals.OUT>=50, by_method.CASH.IN>=100, by_method.CASH.OUT>=50, by_method.UPI.IN>=200), expenses report asserts (transaction_count>=1, total>=50, by_category TEST_Expense>=50, by_method.CASH>=50, by_staff amount>=50 & count>=1), regression on /api/reports/daily shape (totals + totals_by_method + shifts + transactions), regression on admin-guarded endpoints (GET /api/admin/dashboard 401 without token, POST /api/staff 401 without token). Frontend: opened ReportsDialog from cash-register reports-btn, confirmed 5 tabs (tab-daily, tab-staff, tab-expenses, tab-x, tab-z), staff-view + staff-date + expenses-view + expenses-date + expenses-total + expenses-export-csv + expenses-export-pdf all render; changing the date input in both Staff and Expenses tabs fires the correct GET /api/reports/staff?day= and /api/reports/expenses?day= calls (captured via page.on('request')). Daily and Z-Report tabs still render — no regression.

issues: DialogDescription still reads 'X-Report (current shift snapshot) & Z-Report (closed shift final).' but the dialog now hosts 5 tabs including Daily, Staff and Expenses. Consider updating the description to reflect all report types.

action_items: Optional: update ReportsDialog DialogDescription text to mention Daily/Staff/Expenses (currently only mentions X and Z reports).
critical_code_review_comments: Both /reports/staff and /reports/expenses use naive ISO string range on opened_at ('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00+00:00'..'23:59:59+00:00'). This works because all timestamps use datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() which yields '+00:00' suffix, but is brittle if timezone handling ever changes. Consider storing datetime objects and querying with datetime bounds.

expenses_report scope is transactions attached to shifts OPENED that day. If a shift opens at 23:55 and OUT is recorded at 00:10 the next day, that OUT still lands in the day-of-opening report and NOT in the next-day report (because both endpoints filter by shifts.opened_at, not transaction.created_at). Confirm this matches product intent — otherwise switch to filtering transactions by created_at.

Both new endpoints are UNAUTHENTICATED — same as /reports/daily/x/z, which is consistent with the current design but every staff txn/name is publicly readable. If required, gate with get_current_admin.
ReportsDialog: the two useEffects on lines 37 and 56 both fire loadDaily(day) when open changes — small double-fetch on dialog open. Minor.

One React hydration warning observed in the Z-report tab: <span> rendered inside <option> (from dev instrumentation attributes on the option's text child). Not caused by app source — it's the x-component instrumentation wrapping the string. Benign, but worth pinning if you run with strict-mode SSR.
seed_data_creation: Opened a shift with existing staff (Amit Kumar), then recorded 3 test transactions (CASH IN 100 TEST_CashSale, UPI IN 200 TEST_UPISale against first available bank, CASH OUT 50 TEST_Expense). Client_ids all prefixed with TEST_it8_. Shift closed in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-8 reporting additions fully verified — backend endpoints return the documented shape and correct aggregations, ReportsDialog exposes both new tabs with correct data-testids (staff-view, expenses-view, staff-date, expenses-date, expenses-total, staff/expenses export buttons) and the network calls fire on date change. Only nits: DialogDescription still says X/Z only; consider filter-by-created_at semantics for expenses/staff around midnight; both endpoints are public (parity with daily/x/z).
